data.name: Name
data.scale: Value sent to the number entity
data.soc_resume_margin: Resume charging this far below the limit (%)
data.stay_tolerance_w: Grid import tolerated to keep running

data_description.entity_id: On/off and proportional: the entity to switch or set. Battery: the number entity of the charge setpoint. EV charger: the number entity of the charging current in amps.
data_description.scale: percent: 0-100 of the maximum power. watts: power in W.
data_description.soc_max: Without a state of charge sensor, a limit below 100 means the device will not charge.
data_description.min_current_a: 6 A is the usual minimum for AC charging (IEC 61851-1); check your charger.
data_description.measured_entity: Real power drawn. Lets the engine free surplus when the device takes less than commanded.
data_description.connected_entity: on = plugged in. Unknown is treated as plugged in. An unplugged car gets nothing, so the surplus goes to lower priorities.
data_description.switch_entity: If set, the charger is switched on/off with it. Otherwise it is paused by setting 0 A (not every charger accepts that).
data_description.phases: Fixed number of phases. Automatic 1/3 phase switching is not supported.

error.invalid_device: Invalid device: power must be > 0 and minimum power cannot exceed it.
